violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SHREDDED LETTUCE AT 47F, SLICED TOMATOES AT 44F, BRISKET AT 46F, GYRO MEAT AT 45F, STEAK NUGGETS AT 45F, PREPPED BURGERS 44F, MAC & CHEESE 44F, PORTIONED MAC & CHEESE 51F, RAW BEEF PATTY 44F, RAW BEEF ROAST 45F SLICED CHEESES 44-47F IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR; PORTIONED GOBBLER AT 44-48F, GYRO MEAT AT 45F, SLICED TURKEY AT 43F IN 1 DOOR UNDER COUNTER REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WALK IN REFRIGERATOR AT 46F AND 1 DOOR FLAT TOP AT 46F AT TIME OF INSPECTION. MOST TCS FOODS STORED IN UNIT WERE BETWEEN 44-48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED FOODS ABOVE 42F DURING INSPECTION; OTHER FOODS WERE RELOCATED. MANAGEMENT REQUESTED SERVICE TECHNICIAN WHILE ON SITE AND WILL CONTACT EHS ONCE UNITS HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean Every 24 Hours
violations.observation: Nozzles of soda dispensers in drive thru unit and in consumer self service unit with accumulation of discolored substances are not being cleaned as required.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and consumer self-service utensils such as tongs, scoops, or ladles. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE NOZZLES FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink: Missing from kitchen handwashing station nearest to walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI - Additional roll of paper towels were provided at station during inspection.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: The back door of the kitchen was kept open for ventilation/other purposes, is not adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents.
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means. CDI - Back kitchen door was closed during the inspection.

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located on top of hot holding station (in close contact with food containers) where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EHS RECOMMENDS RELOCATING INSECT TRAP/ZAPPER TO AN AREA WHERE NO FOOD PREP/EQUIPMENT STORAGE WILL TAKE PLACE, SUCH AS ABOVE WALKWAYS RATHER THAN FIXED STORAGE/WORK STATIONS.
